plan_name: Individual Health Insurance Policy – Platinum / Gold / Senior Citizen

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room taken; not applied where differential billing is not followed

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day or actuals, whichever is less

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: Applicable for Gold and Senior Citizen plans only. Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000/eye; Hernia & Hysterectomy: lower of 25% SI or ₹1,00,000; Major surgeries (cardiac, brain tumour, pacemaker, cancer, hip/knee/joint replacement, organ transplant): up to 70% of SI. Platinum plan has no such sub-limits.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible specified in the base policy

initial_waiting.note: Applicable for Gold and Senior Citizen plans; not explicitly stated for Platinum but standard IRDAI clause included

ped_waiting.note: Applicable for Gold and Senior Citizen plans. Platinum plan wording does not list waiting periods under Section IV.A, suggesting they may not apply, but the document is ambiguous; 48 months stated for Gold/Senior Citizen.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Table A diseases (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, calculus, etc.) – 24 months; Table B diseases (joint replacement degenerative, neurodegenerative, ARMD) – 48 months. Applicable for Gold and Senior Citizen plans.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 30 days prior to admission; combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI (cap not applicable for Platinum plan)

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered up to 60 days after discharge; combined pre+post capped at 10% of SI (cap not applicable for Platinum plan)

day_care.note: All day-care treatments as per definition are covered under in-patient hospitalisation clause

domiciliary.note: Covered on reimbursement basis; first 3 days not payable; several diseases excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.); annual limit per Annexure-3 (e.g. ₹45,000 for ₹3L SI)

ayush.note: Only Ayurvedic treatment covered as in-patient in a recognised AYUSH Hospital; other AYUSH systems (Homeopathy, Unani, Siddha, Yoga) are excluded per specific exclusion clause

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses for organ donor covered (excluding cost of organ) under in-patient clause, subject to Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

ambulance.note: Road ambulance cover limited to ₹2,500 per person per policy period; payable only if in-patient claim is admitted

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.

consumables.note: Consumables and non-medical items listed in Annexure-1 are excluded; no optional rider for consumables mentioned

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts coverage to India only

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for renewal; coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, congenital external anomalies, hearing aids, spectacles, dental (unless accident/disease needing hospitalisation), stem cell (except bone marrow), RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric O2

optional_riders.display: Daily Cash Allowance (₹250/day or ₹500/day optional add-on)
